Huge disappointment with a huge price
Aug 2026 • Couples
Sadly we had a very poor experience dining in Chic restaurant whilst hotel residents. Initially, we found the menu confusing and not overly appealing. Is it French, Vietnamese, International or a mismatch of anything and everything. It is a huge and beautiful dining room. On the evening we dined there, only a handful of tables were occupied. We ordered four dishes. Whilst the presentation was good, the taste of all four dishes was just plain weird and unappetising. They were also over cooked and took an awful long time to arrive. We didn’t finish any dish. It would take too long to explain so I’ll save you the details. The price for the food and drinks is extremely high for Vietnam, more in line with Western pricing. If the food had been exceptional we’d have been happy to pay exceptional prices. As a final note several experiences of poached egg at breakfast resulted in almost raw eggs. Not difficult to cook a poached egg? Overall our dining experiences in Vietnam the last 3 weeks has been good to great so this was a huge let down in what is the best hotel we’ve stayed in. Do yourself a favour and go out to dine in local restaurants outside the hotel 😏

As a footnote, I did have the opportunity to discuss our experience with Oliver, the Head Chef. He offered to give us a special experience the following evening whilst also saying no-one else has complained about the food! We politely declined.

Not worth it, Worst experience the entire trip
Mar 2026 • Friends
I scheduled a reservation 1 week prior to leaving for our girls trip through email. I let them know it was for my friends birthday. In the email i was told there would be candles and rose petals (if available). The table had rose petals and a couple tea light candles. I went up to see if they had a birthday desert option i was told i had to give 24hr notice for a cake not communicated in the email at all. I went ahead and just ordered a desert off the menu and they wrote on the plate. the service was horrendous. there was a total of maybe 5 tables outside of us and it took then 40 min to take our order, we watched them check up on the tables around us multiple times but never did this for us. The food was not only not impressive it tasted spoiled in my dish. We had a friend ask if we could split the check and they said yes and then proceeded to say it would take 30 min to do so. we had no issues paying for it together it was just a question with very poor communication from the staff. this was the one place we had to question if our skin color had anything to do with the service. it was almost like the staff avoided our table the entire time we were there. For the caliber the website advertises, the service was the worst our entire 2 weeks in Vietnam

When catering meets the requirements of setting, service and quality
May 2025 • Couples
If you pass through Sapa, do not hesitate to push the doors of the Hotel de la Coupole to enjoy a meal in its Chic restaurant. The original decoration of the establishment fantasizes the fashion milieu of the Roaring Twenties in a setting that lives up to such a tribute. The menu presents regional specialties but also classics of French cuisine, all being well executed. Prices in kVND are in the high range of European restaurants and exclude taxes and services like most restaurants in Vietnam. Alcoholic beverages are charged separately from the rest of the meal.

Delicious Food - Magnificent Surroundings
Dec 2024 • Couples
We are staying in this amazing, over-the-top hotel, in the mountains, in the North West of Vietnam. 

Their restaurant, Chic, is an almost palace-sized room, beautifully decorated. The menu is "a gastronomic menu of classic French dishes crafted from the finest local ingredients". 

The waiters and waitresses were delightful: English-speaking, very polite, friendly and helpful. 

We chose: 

 - Chic style French onion soup: Beef consommé, onion jam, bread crumbs, Edam cheese ball

 - Comte-Chardonnay Soup: Truffles, avocado-crab ball, chilli oil

 - Roasted rack of black pork: Doi leaves & sauce, Sichuan pepper, chayote vegetables, purple rice

My cheese soup was rich and deliciously flavoured with just the right amount of truffle. The pork was just cooked over pink - perfect. Full of flavour. Excellent meal in amazing surroundings. 

(Also posted to my food blog on Instagram @AbbeyKing16)
